1. Go to the source area (black floor)
2. Pick up items from one specific half (blue OR green wall)
3. Return to the nest (white floor)

- State 0: Explore/go toward source (black floor)

- State 2: Return to nest (go toward red wall)

- When on black floor → try to go to specific color wall
- When on white floor → delivered, go back out
